- Please check the "Appearance Rates" tab for the members that can appear.
- The same member may appear more than once in the Release Celebration Scout.
- Appearance rates are rounded to the fifth decimal place.
As such, the sum of the individual appearance rates may differ from the total appearance rate shown.
- Due to display limitations, the appearance rates may not add up to 100%.

For example, a member with a 1% rate is not guaranteed to join even once in 100 pulls.
- For details on appearance rates, please check the Appearance Rates tab.
- Even if the app is force-closed or the connection is lost so the Scout results screen does not display properly after performing the Release Celebration Scout, the Scout is still processed correctly. Please check your member list and Penlight count.
- Members appearing in this Scout may appear again in the future.
- This Scout may be made available again in the future.
- The availability period and contents are subject to change without notice.
- Scout Tickets can be used via "Scout with Tickets" at the lower right of the screen.
　Tickets not shown in "Scout with Tickets" cannot be used for this Scout.
- When a member you have already recruited would join again on the second time or later, you instead receive Penlights according to their rarity.
　R Member: 20
　SR Member: 50
　UR Member: 500
- Scout Points you obtain are automatically converted into 1 Skill Book (M) when the Scout ends.
